'''2012 Bespin Regionals Mitch Nieland DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
